items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued September 11 at 2:02PM AKDT until September 12 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...High surf expected. Water levels 2 to 4 feet above the
normal high tide line, peaking during each high tide.

* WHERE...Western Arctic Coast and Kotzebue Sound.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur.
items.areas: Kivalina and Red Dog Dock; Lower Kobuk Valley; Baldwin Peninsula; Northern Seward Peninsula
items.instruction: Precautions should be taken to protect property.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued September 11 at 2:02PM AKDT until September 12 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...High surf and erosion expected with water levels rising
up to 3 feet above the normal high tide line Saturday afternoon.

* WHERE...Northern Arctic Coast.

* WHEN...From 10 PM this evening to 10 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion will occur.
